arXiv:2606.32032v1 [cs.CL] 2026 年 6 月 30 日arXiv:2606.32032v1 [cs.CL] 30 Jun 2026

具有元认知反馈的强化学习在法学硕士中引发了忠实的不确定性表达Reinforcement Learning with Metacognitive Feedback Elicits Faithful Uncertainty Expression in LLMs

Gabrielle Kaili-May Liu1 Avi Caciularu2  Gal Yona2 Idan Szpektor2 Arman Cohan1

1Yale University  2Google Research
{kaili.liu, arman.cohan}@yale.edu
摘要Abstract

元认知是智力的重要组成部分，它描述了监控和调节自身认知过程的能力。然而，法学硕士在关键元认知能力方面表现出系统性缺陷：他们高度自信地产生幻觉，无法识别知识边界，并歪曲其内部不确定性，从而破坏了可信度和可靠性。由于监控任务绩效并相应地调整行为是元认知的核心，因此我们认为能够准确判断自身绩效的模型更有能力改进它。我们通过两种新颖的机制来实施这个想法：Metacognition is a critical component of intelligence that describes the ability to monitor and regulate one’s own cognitive processes. Yet LLMs exhibit systemic deficiencies in key metacognitive faculties: they hallucinate with high confidence, fail to recognize knowledge boundaries, and misrepresent their internal uncertainty—undermining trustworthiness and reliability. Since monitoring task performance and adapting behavior accordingly are central to metacognition, we posit that models capable of accurately judging their own performance are better positioned to improve it. We operationalize this idea via two novel mechanisms:具有元认知反馈的强化学习reinforcement learning with metacognitive feedback (RLMF），一种在偏好优化期间根据模型自我判断性能的质量来细化完成排名的范例，以及), a paradigm to refine completion rankings during preference optimization based on the quality of a model’s self-judgments of performance, and元认知数据选择metacognitive data selection，它使用类似的自我判断来识别高价值的训练示例，优于朴素的主动学习。我们将这些创新应用于忠实校准（FC）问题，这项任务本身从根本上来说是元认知的：目标是用内在的不确定性来表达，即使对于前沿法学硕士来说也很困难。我们采用两阶段、解耦的方法，首先使用这些方法来校准模型自我报告的置信度得分的真实性，然后通过有针对性的输出编辑映射到自然的、上下文适应的语言不确定性。大量实验表明, which uses similar self-judgments to identify high-value training examples, outperforming naive active learning. We apply these innovations to the problem of faithful calibration (FC), a task that is itself fundamentally metacognitive: the goal is to align expressed with intrinsic uncertainty, difficult even for frontier LLMs. We adopt a two-stage, decoupled approach, first using these methods to calibrate the faithfulness of models’ self-reported confidence scores, then mapping to natural, context-adaptable linguistic uncertainty via targeted output editing. Extensive experiments showRLMF在保持准确性的同时，在不同的任务上实现了可推广的、最先进的 FC。此外，achieves generalizable, state-of-the-art FC on diverse tasks while preserving accuracy. Further,RLMF超出标准 RL 高达 63%，同时增强模型评估和表达自身能力限制的能力。这个职位surpasses standard RL by up to 63% while enhancing models’ ability to assess and express their own capability limits. This positionsRLMF作为增强 LLM 元认知以提高能力和一致性的有前途的范例，并建议将元认知性能作为有效的 RL 信号来克服先前内在反馈方法的限制。as a promising paradigm to enhance LLM metacognition toward improved abilities and alignment, and suggests metacognitive performance as an effective RL signal to overcome limits of prior intrinsic feedback methods.111我们的代码位于Our code is provided athttps://github.com/yale-nlp/RLMF.

1 简介Introduction

元认知是智力的基本组成部分，是指监控、评估和调节自身认知过程的能力Metacognition is a foundational component of intelligence that refers to the ability to monitor, assess, and regulate one’s own cognitive processes[23]。它对于有效学习、决策和沟通至关重要，并且越来越被认为是强大、透明的人工智能系统的基石. It is critical to effective learning, decision-making, and communication and has become increasingly recognized as a cornerstone of capable, transparent AI systems[88]。尽管如此，法学硕士仍然表现出关键的元认知缺陷，包括无法识别知识边界. Despite this, LLMs continue to exhibit key metacognitive deficiencies, including failure to recognize knowledge boundaries[89]，高度自信的幻觉倾向, tendency toward high-confidence hallucinations[83]，以及对其内部不确定性的系统性歪曲, and systematic misrepresentation of their internal uncertainty[113, 62]。缺乏强大的元认知能力会损害可信度和可靠性，特别是当模型被部署在科学发现等高风险环境中的下游咨询角色时. This lack of robust metacognitive faculties undermines trustworthiness and reliability, particularly as models are deployed in downstream advisory roles across high-stakes settings such as scientific discovery[85, 122], 医学诊断, medical diagnosis[46, 130]、法律咨询, and legal consulting[15, 55].

由于监控任务绩效并相应地调整行为的能力是元认知的核心，因此我们假设模型能够准确判断 他们自己的表现更有能力提高，使元认知信号成为训练后监督的自然来源。 我们特别建议利用As the ability to monitor task performance and adapt behavior accordingly is central to metacognition, we posit that models made capable of accurately judging their own performance are better positioned to improve it, making metacognitive signals a natural source of supervision during post-training. In particular, we propose leveraging元认知表现metacognitive performance作为法学硕士的额外训练信号——将元认知意识编码到模型中，同时提高任务绩效。as an additional training signal for LLMs—to encode metacognitive awareness into models while simultaneously improving task performance.

我们通过两种新颖的机制来实施这个想法（图 1）。We operationalize this idea via two novel mechanisms (Fig.1）。首先我们介绍一下). First, we introduce具有元认知反馈的强化学习reinforcement learning with metacognitive feedback (RLMF), 一种训练范式，其中模型不仅会因为产生强大的输出而获得奖励，而且还会因为准确判断其表现如何而获得奖励。), a training paradigm in which the model is rewarded not only for producing strong outputs, but also for accurately judging how well it performed.RLMF之前的工作表明，内在信心信号可以作为有效的 RL 奖励，但通过利用模型对其自身性能的评估质量而不是简单地输出信心，在更高的抽象级别上运行。 具体来说，我们引入了一种新颖的元认知优势缩放机制：在强化学习训练期间，我们使用模型自我判断的准确性来缩放每个完成的优势，即相对学习信号，决定与其他采样完成相比，完成的强化程度。 来补充builds upon prior work showing that intrinsic confidence signals can serve as effective RL rewards, but operates at a higher level of abstraction by leveraging the quality of the model’s assessment of its own performance rather than simply output confidence. Concretely, we introduce a novel metacognitive advantage scaling mechanism: during RL training, we use the accuracy of the model’s self-judgments to scale each completion’s advantage, i.e., the relative learning signal that determines how strongly that completion is reinforced compared to alternative sampled completions. To complementRLMF，我们另外建议, we additionally propose元认知数据选择metacognitive data selection，它使用模型的自我评估来选择信息丰富的训练示例： 候选示例根据模型认为其性能的好坏进行评分，并且选择该范围的高分和低分两端的示例进行训练，因为每个示例都提供了互补的学习信号。, which uses the model’s self-assessments to choose informative training examples: candidate examples are scored by how well the model believes it performed, and examples from both the high- and low-scoring ends of this spectrum are selected for training, since each provides a complementary learning signal.

我们通过将这些创新应用于以下问题来展示其功效We showcase the efficacy of these innovations by applying them to the problem of忠实的校准faithful calibration（FC），一项本身就是元认知的任务：目标是使模型能够表达真正反映其（估计的）内在信心的不确定性，即使对于前沿法学硕士来说也是一个挑战(FC), a task that is itself metacognitive: the goal is to enable models to express uncertainty that genuinely reflects their (estimated) intrinsic confidence, a challenge even for frontier LLMs[62, 24, 61]。 FC 与更普遍研究的问题不同. FC is distinct from the more commonly studied problem of事实校准factual calibration，将置信度与经验准确性结合起来, which aligns confidence with empirical accuracy[103]：一个模型可能看起来经过事实校准，但仍然与其内部信念不一致。 FC 捕获这种关键故障模式来校准用户的依赖度并提高可信度。然而，据我们所知，FC 很大程度上尚未得到解决，现有方法在范围和普遍性方面受到限制，并且没有一个方法能够在数字和语言不确定性方面全面解决 FC 问题。: a model may appear factually calibrated yet remain misaligned with its internal beliefs. FC captures this critical failure mode to calibrate user reliance and improve trustworthiness. Yet, to our knowledge, FC is largely unresolved, with existing approaches limited in scope and generalizability and none addressing FC holistically across both numerical and linguistic uncertainty.

针对法学硕士的端到端 FC，我们提出了一个两阶段框架。首先，Toward end-to-end FC of LLMs, we propose a two-stage framework. First,RLMF元认知数据选择用于校准模型自我报告的句子级置信度得分的可信度。然后，我们通过将每个分数映射到适当的模糊表达式并修改响应的连贯性和流畅性，将这些忠实的数字分数转换为自然的和上下文适应的语言不确定性。 这会产生更值得信赖的and metacognitive data selection are applied to calibrate the faithfulness of models’ self-reported sentence-level confidence scores. Then, we convert these faithful numerical scores into natural and context-adaptable linguistic uncertainty, by mapping each score to appropriate hedge expressions and revising the response for coherence and fluency. This yields a more trustworthy[124]并以人为本and human-aligned[5]供用户校准其对模型输出的依赖的媒介。 此外，这两个阶段在设计上是解耦的：阶段 1 可以运行一次，而阶段 2 可以适应不同的用户偏好和环境，而无需重复昂贵的 RL 训练。medium for users to calibrate their reliance on model outputs. Moreover, the two stages are decoupled by design: Stage 1 can be run once, while Stage 2 can accommodate diverse user preferences and contexts without repeating costly RL training.

跨多个法学硕士和 10 个任务进行评估Evaluated across multiple LLMs and 10 tasks spanning6+6+在内容领域，我们的框架实现了最先进的 FC，尽管在单个数据集上进行训练，但仍能在任务之间稳健地泛化，同时与之前的方法不同，保持任务准确性和事实校准。消融研究验证了我们的元认知方法的贡献及其相对于各自基线的优越性。我们证明content domains, our framework achieves state-of-the-art FC, generalizing robustly across tasks despite training on a single dataset, while preserving task accuracy and factual calibration unlike prior methods. Ablation studies validate the contribution of our metacognitive methods and their superiority over respective baselines. We demonstrate thatRLMF提高模型自我评估目标任务表现的能力。系统的人类评估进一步显示平均improves models’ ability to self-assess performance on a target task. Systematic human evaluation further shows an average96%在跨不同任务和用户偏好的语言不确定性的多样性、自然性、有用性和上下文适用性方面，胜率高于最强基线。总结一下：win rate over the strongest baseline in diversity, naturalness, helpfulness, and contextual suitability of linguistic uncertainty across diverse tasks and user preferences. To summarize:

  1. 1.

    我们介绍We introduce具有元认知反馈的强化学习reinforcement learning with metacognitive feedback (RLMF），一个新颖的范式 根据模型自我判断性能的质量，在偏好优化期间完善完成排名， 与标准强化学习相比，训练后结果增强高达 63%，同时赋予模型改进的元认知意识。), a novel paradigm to refine completion rankings during preference optimization based on the quality of a model’s self-judgments of performance, which strengthens post-training results by up to 63% over standard RL while conferring models with improved metacognitive awareness.

  2. 2.

    我们建立We establish the第一个端到端管道first end-to-end pipeline忠实地校准数值to faithfully calibrate numerical和and法学硕士发出的语言不确定性表达式，在模型和任务中取得了最先进的结果。linguistic uncertainty expressions emitted by LLMs, achieving state-of-the-art results across models and tasks.

  3. 3.

    我们表明，可以利用模型的自我评估性能来管理有效的训练数据（我们称之为We show that models’ self-assessed performance can be leveraged to curate effective training data (which we term元认知数据选择metacognitive data selection），表现优于朴素 以及模型处理不佳的主动学习式示例选择。), outperforming both naive and active-learning-style selection of examples the model handles poorly.

  4. 4.

    我们制定有原则的、以人为本的 从数字到语言置信度的映射方法，提高了法学硕士不确定性交流的自然性和适应性。We develop a principled, human-aligned mapping approach from numerical to linguistic confidence, improving naturalness and adaptability of LLM uncertainty communication.

2 相关工作Related Work

法学硕士中的元认知。Metacognition in LLMs.

元认知——监控和控制自己认知过程的能力Metacognition—the ability to monitor and control one’s own cognitive processes[23]——是认知、学习和不确定性沟通的核心组成部分—is a central component of cognition, learning, and uncertainty communication[88]在各种任务中都注意到了法学硕士的不足whose deficiency in LLMs has been noted across various tasks[31, 125, 41]并假设它是导致幻觉和其他失调表达的主要因素。尽管元认知很重要，但法学硕士的元认知直到最近才受到关注and hypothesized to contribute centrally to hallucinations and other misaligned expressions. Despite its importance, metacognition in LLMs has only recently gained traction[73, 78], 精选作品表明元认知方法可以提高下游绩效, with select works showing metacognitive methods can improve downstream performance[62, 18, 95, 101, 131]。 我们以这些进展为基础，建议在强化学习期间优先完成任务，使模型表现出更强的元认知能力，并受到首先令人满意的任务级奖励信号的影响。我们的假设是，如果一个模型能够学习预测其在目标任务上的表现（通过如何对候选完成情况进行排名来强化这种技能），那么它还可以获得有关如何调整其生成以获得更好性能的隐含信号。正如我们所展示的，这种机制不仅增强了训练后的结果，而且同时提高了模型识别和表达自身能力水平的能力，朝着更好的元认知监控和调整迈进。. We build upon these developments to propose prioritizing completions during RL for which a model exhibits stronger metacognitive capabilities, subject to first satisfying task-level reward signals. Our hypothesis is that if a model can learn to predict its performance on a target task, a skill reinforced via how candidate completions are ranked, then it can also acquire implicit signals on how to adjust its generations to achieve better performance. As we show, this mechanism not only strengthens post-training outcomes, but also simultaneously improves the model’s ability to recognize and express its own capability level, stepping toward better metacognitive monitoring and alignment.

具有内部反馈的强化学习。Reinforcement Learning with Internal Feedback.

自从带有人类反馈的强化学习出现以来Since the advent of RL with human feedback[74, 52]，已经出现了许多为法学硕士的强化学习设计更有效、更有针对性的奖励信号的方法。最近的一类方法是带有内部反馈的强化学习, numerous methods to devise more effective, targeted reward signals for RL of LLMs have emerged. One recent class of approach is RL with internal feedback[121, 123]，它利用从模型本身派生的无监督奖励信号来绕过对昂贵的外部反馈的需求。使用内部置信信号, which leverages unsupervised reward signals derived from the model itself to bypass the need for expensive external feedback. The use of internal confidence signals[54, 97, 116]，比如自我肯定, such as self-certainty[127, 57]或熵or entropy[1]，因为奖励对于提高成绩特别有效, as rewards has been particularly fruitful for improving事实的factual校准，除了直接调整校准指标（例如 Brier 分数）以进行显式优化calibration, in addition to direct adaptation of calibration metrics (e.g., Brier score) for explicit optimization[59, 86, 16]。进一步的研究考虑了 GRPO 倍增的价值. Further studies have considered the value of multiplying GRPO[79]从置信信号导出的标量的优势advantages by a scalar derived from confidence signals[13, 63, 118, 104]例如语义熵。 受到这些作品的启发，我们建议 杠杆such as semantic entropy. Inspired by such works, we propose to leverage元认知 表现metacognitive performance作为额外的反馈信号，在 RL 训练期间优先对完成情况进行排名，并将 RL 应用于as an additional feedback signal to preferentially rank completions during RL training, and apply RL for忠实的faithful校准。 据我们所知，这标志着法学硕士在强化学习期间首次使用此类元认知反馈。 我们强调calibration. To the best of our knowledge, this marks the first use of such metacognitive feedback during RL for LLMs. We highlight具有元认知反馈的强化学习reinforcement learning with metacognitive feedback (RLMF）作为一种有前景的新方法，其性能优于标准强化学习，并赋予模型更好的元认知意识。) as a promising new method which outperforms standard RL and confers models with better metacognitive awareness.

法学硕士的忠实校准。Faithful Calibration of LLMs.

模型可能看起来经过事实校准，但仍然与其内部信念不一致Models can appear factually calibrated yet remain misaligned with their internal beliefs[113, 25, 62, 24, 61]。 这种缺乏. This lack of忠实的校准faithful calibration(FC) 对人工智能工具的用户依赖和安全使用构成风险(FC) poses risks to user reliance and safe use of AI tools[129]。 现有的理解、基准测试和改进 FC 的工作主要集中在. Existing efforts to understand, benchmark, and improve FC have focused exclusively on语言学的linguistic不确定性。 然而，这些方法仅产生了有限的改进，并且范围和适用性有限。元认知提示uncertainty. Yet these approaches produce only modest improvements and are limited in scope and applicability. Metacognitive prompting[62]取决于指令遵循并降低任务准确性；转向is contingent on instruction-following and degrades task accuracy; steering[42]仅限于开放权重模型，并依赖于限制对新上下文的可扩展性的预定义探针；以及使用 SFT 的简单句子模板is limited to open-weight models and relies on predefined probes that restrict extensibility to novel contexts; and use of simplistic sentence templates for SFT[20]限制泛化和语言多样性 同时产生不自然的重复结构。 至关重要的是，这些作品都没有涉及忠实的人constrains generalization and linguistic diversity while yielding unnatural, repetitive structures. Crucially, none of these works addresses faithful数值numerical尽管自我报告的置信度分数可以作为易于解释的输出可靠性信号，但不确定性仍然存在。他们也没有考虑整个生成文本中模糊限制语的自然性和连贯性，这在长格式环境中很重要。 令人满意的解决方案必须超越简单的每句话对冲，动态地改变响应中不确定性的表达方式，反映人类如何跨语域调整对冲策略。 我们解决这些缺点以实现uncertainty, despite the utility of self-reported confidence scores as easily interpretable signals of output reliability. Nor do they consider the naturalness and coherence of hedges across an entire generated text, important in long-form settings. A satisfactory solution must go beyond simple per-sentence hedging to dynamically vary how uncertainty is expressed across a response, mirroring how humans adapt hedging strategies across registers. We address these shortcomings to achieve整体的holistic法学硕士的 FC。据我们所知，之前没有任何工作针对类似范围的这个问题，也没有探索 RL 对于 FC 的价值。FC of LLMs. To the best of our knowledge, no prior work has targeted this problem with similar scope, nor explored the value of RL for FC.

3 方法Method

我们建议利用元认知反馈来改进偏好优化和训练数据选择，通过应用该范式实现法学硕士的整体忠实校准（FC）来展示该范式的价值。 具体来说，我们用它来校准模型自我报告的置信度得分的可信度，并将其与有针对性的重写阶段配对，以将结果映射到语言设置。 这种解耦方法确保语言不确定性表达式 (1) 可以定制和修改，以适应用户偏好和其他上下文，而无需重复昂贵的 RL 训练；(2) 具有多样性，因为 RL 容易出现模式崩溃，而忠实的校准指标不会惩罚对冲重复We propose to leverage metacognitive feedback to improve preference optimization and training data selection, demonstrating the value of this paradigm by applying it to achieve holistic faithful calibration (FC) of LLMs. Specifically, we use it to calibrate the faithfulness of models’ self-reported confidence scores, and pair it with a targeted rewriting stage to map the results to the linguistic setting. This decoupled approach ensures linguistic uncertainty expressions (1) can be tailored and modified to suit user preferences and other context without repeating costly RL training, and (2) are diverse, since RL is prone to mode collapse and faithful calibration metrics do not penalize hedge repetition[113].

3.4 重写协议Rewriting Protocol

为进一步发挥优势To further capitalize on the merits ofRLMF, 我们对模型输出进行有针对性的编辑，以确保忠实, we use targeted editing of model outputs to enable faithful语言学的linguistic不确定性表达式可以跨场景动态适应并可推广到长格式任务。 现有的工作表明，即使有专门的提示，法学硕士也很难以类似人类的方式选择和使用模糊限制语uncertainty expression that is dynamically adaptable across scenarios and generalizable to long-form tasks. Existing work shows LLMs struggle to select and use hedges in a human-like fashion even with specialized prompting[62]。因此，我们构建了从置信度分数到对冲表达式的原则性映射，并应用策略重写将其合并到模型输出中（图 1）。. We therefore construct a principled mapping from confidence scores to hedge expressions and apply strategic rewriting to incorporate these into model outputs (Fig.1b).这使得 灵活、分布均匀、适合任务且自然 可以适应用户偏好的语言不确定性（例如风格、预期受众）， 无需针对不同环境重复进行昂贵的强化学习训练。b). This enables flexible, well-distributed, task-appropriate, and naturalistic linguistic uncertainty that can accommodate user preferences (e.g., style, expected audience), without the need to repeat costly RL training for different contexts.

给定句子级的忠实置信度分数，重写是通过提示一个强大的、具有成本效益的LLM来执行的，其中包括（1）原始响应，（2）与每个句子的置信度分数相对应的候选模糊限制，以及（3）特定于任务和/或用户的细节（例如风格、目标受众、特定领域的约定）来指导模糊限制选择和文本编辑。正如我们在§中所示Given sentence-level faithful confidence scores, rewriting is performed by prompting a strong, cost-effective LLM with (1) the original response, (2) candidate hedges corresponding to each sentence’s confidence score, and (3) task- and/or user-specific details (e.g., style, target audience, domain-specific conventions) to guide hedges selection and text editing. As we show in §5，这个过程实现了强大的数字-语言忠实校准对应，同时提高了法学硕士语言不确定性与人类判断的现有方法相比的自然性和上下文适应性。我们在§中提供提示并描述得分-对冲映射的构建, this process enables strong numerical–linguistic faithful calibration correspondence while improving the naturalness and contextual suitability of LLMs’ linguistic uncertainty versus prior methods as judged by humans. We provide prompts and describe the construction of the score–hedge mapping in §B.3和§and §C.4，并与§中结合句子级和整体响应修订的更细粒度的两步重写方法进行比较, and compare against a more fine-grained two-step rewriting approach that combines sentence-level and whole-response revisions in §C.4.2.

4 实验装置Experimental Setup

我们进行了广泛的实验来评估我们的元认知方法对于改善法学硕士 FC 的有效性，涵盖数字和语言不确定性表达。We conduct extensive experiments to evaluate the efficacy of our metacognitive approach for improving FC of LLMs, spanning both numerical and linguistic uncertainty expression.

数据集和基准。Datasets & Benchmarks.

我们使用涵盖不同格式、内容领域和难度级别的 10 个数据集来评估 FC 性能。 为了避免潜在的数据集大小偏差，我们遵循之前的工作We evaluate FC performance using a suite of 10 datasets spanning diverse formats, content domains, and difficulty levels. To avoid potential dataset size bias, we follow prior work[113, 62]从每个数据集的测试拆分中抽取 1000 个示例进行评估。数据集列表和更多详细信息参见§to sample 1000 examples from the test split of each dataset for evaluation. The dataset list and further details are in §B.2.

模型和培训详细信息。Models and Training Details.

我们将我们的方法应用于两个广泛使用的模型系列的法学硕士：Qwen3（1.7B、4B、8B）We apply our approach to LLMs from two widely used model families: Qwen3 (1.7B, 4B, 8B)[109]和 Llama3.1-指导 (8B)and Llama3.1-Instruct (8B)[29]。 这些是代表不同架构和参数规模的开源模型；我们使用指令调整的变体来展示我们的训练管道的补充价值。 在 RL 训练之前，模型首先经过 SFT. These are capable open-source models representing varying architectures and parameter scales; we use the instruction-tuned variants to demonstrate the complementary value of our training pipeline. Prior to RL training, models first undergo SFT777详细信息见§Details are in §B.1。我们通过§中的消融研究评估了SFT前阶段的贡献. We assess the contribution of the pre-SFT stage via ablation study in §C.1.6.学习我们的自定义输出格式，将其推广到任务中，并遵守特定于任务的输出长度。然后我们申请to learn our custom output format, generalize it across tasks, and adhere to task-specific output lengths. We then applyRLMF到每个模型的最佳检查点（§中的程序）to the best checkpoint per model (procedure in §B.1), 使用), usingNtrainRLMF=2000N_{\text{train}}^{\texttt{RLMF}}=2000从 PopQA 训练集中元认知地选择样本。我们使用 PopQA 来确保与之前工作的可比性metacognitively selected samples from the PopQA training set. We use PopQA to ensure comparability to prior work[20]因为这是一项具有挑战性的开放域 QA 任务。这种设置可以对分布外泛化进行严格评估，因为模型是在单个数据集上进行训练并在广泛的任务和内容域上进行评估的。我们还通过在 SelfAware、UMWP 或 HaluEval 上进行交替训练来测试我们选择训练数据的方法的稳健性。最后，我们通过消融来研究我们方法中每个元认知成分的贡献，这些消融消除了元认知优势缩放或将我们的数据选择方法与无特殊选择和主动学习风格的基线进行比较。 我们使用Gemini-2.5-Flash-Liteand since it is a challenging open-domain QA task. This setup enables rigorous assessment of out-of-distribution generalization, as models are trained on a single dataset and evaluated on a wide range of tasks and content domains. We additionally test the robustness of our approach to the choice of training data by alternatively training on SelfAware, UMWP, or HaluEval. Finally, we study the contribution of each metacognitive component of our approach via ablations that that remove metacognitive advantage scaling or compare our data selection method against no special selection and an active-learning-style baseline. 由于之前的工作仅研究了语言 FC，因此我们报告了数值和语言 FC 结果，但限制了与语言环境中的先前方法的比较。具体来说，我们比较As prior work has only studied linguistic FC, we report both numerical and linguistic FC results but restrict comparison to prior methods to the linguistic setting. 6 结论Conclusion

我们介绍了We introducedRLMF，一种新颖的范式，通过利用模型自身的隐式性能判断来完善偏好优化期间的完成排名， 与元认知数据选择一起，元认知数据选择使用类似的自我判断来识别比简单的主动学习更有效的训练数据。我们应用这些贡献构建了第一个用于法学硕士整体忠实校准（FC）的端到端框架，提出了一种两阶段解耦方法，以稳健地将模型在数字和语言上表达的不确定性与其内在置信度保持一致。综合实验表明，该框架在不同的模型和任务中实现了强大且可泛化的 FC，超越了先前的最先进技术，同时保持了任务准确性和事实校准。它还使法学硕士能够改进自我评估表现，发布高度忠实的自我报告置信度分数，并以自然、适合上下文的方式调节语言不确定性。作为这些评估的一部分，我们引入了, a novel paradigm to refine completion rankings during preference optimization by leveraging a model’s own implicit judgments of performance, alongside metacognitive data selection, which uses similar self-judgments to identify more effective training data than simple active learning. We applied these contributions to build the first end-to-end framework for holistic faithful calibration (FC) of LLMs, presenting a two-stage decoupled approach to robustly align models’ numerically and linguistically expressed uncertainty with their intrinsic confidence. Comprehensive experiments showed this framework achieves strong and generalizable FC across diverse models and tasks, outperforming the prior state-of-the-art while preserving task accuracy and factual calibration. It also enables LLMs to improve at self-assessment of performance, emit highly faithful self-reported confidence scores, and modulate linguistic uncertainty in a naturalistic, context-appropriate fashion. As part of these evaluations, we introducedMFGcMFG*，一种新指标，通过消除内在置信度在有限范围内的模型的估计偏差来改进其前身。更广泛地说，我们的结果表明*, a new metric that improves upon its predecessor by removing estimation bias for models whose intrinsic confidence occupies a limited range. More broadly, our results suggestRLMF作为实现更强大、更稳定的训练后的有前途的范例，同时将改进的元认知意识编码到法学硕士中，表明元认知表现作为强化学习训练的一种特别有效的内部反馈信号，可以克服先前内在反馈方法的局限性，对一致性和自主学习具有更广泛的影响。as a promising paradigm for achieving stronger and more stable post-training while encoding improved metacognitive awareness into LLMs, suggesting metacognitive performance as a particularly effective internal feedback signal for RL training that can overcome limitations of prior intrinsic feedback methods, with broader implications for alignment and self-directed learning.

道德声明Ethics Statement

这项工作研究使用元认知信号来教导模型更好地监控自己的任务表现并从中学习，利用人类元认知的原理来改善训练后的结果以及对不确定性进行忠实、人性化的沟通。 忠诚度是置信度校准中一个非常有价值但尚未得到充分研究的方面，对于提高法学硕士的可信度和可靠性至关重要。改进的忠实校准和元认知意识可能支持更可靠的弃权行为，使模型能够在不确定或可能错误时更好地识别、预测和发出信号。这些能力尤其重要，因为法学硕士越来越多地部署在人工智能辅助的科学规划和发现等高风险环境中，其中内在不确定性的错误沟通可能会导致重大挫折或其他负面后果。我们的方法在模型和任务中的普遍性表明了在不同环境中提高法学硕士可靠性的潜力。我们的解耦策略进一步促进了语言不确定性的适应性，以适应不同的文化交流规范This work studies the use of metacognitive signals to teach models to better monitor and learn from their own task performance, drawing on principles of human metacognition to improve post-training outcomes and the faithful, human-aligned communication of uncertainty. Faithfulness is a highly valuable yet understudied aspect of confidence calibration that is critical to improving the trustworthiness and reliability of LLMs. Improved faithful calibration and metacognitive awareness may support more reliable abstention behavior, enabling models to better recognize, predict, and signal when they are uncertain or likely to be wrong. These capabilities are especially important as LLMs are increasingly deployed in high-stakes contexts such as AI-assisted scientific planning and discovery, where faulty communication of intrinsic uncertainty could lead to significant setbacks or other negative consequences. The generalizability of our approach across models and tasks suggests potential for improving LLM reliability in diverse settings. Our decoupled strategy further facilitates adaptability of linguistic uncertainty to accommodate different cultural communication norms[53, 108, 70, 69]。更一般地说，改进的忠实度和自我评估能力并不能替代验证，需要进行批判性评估以确保模型响应的真实性。系统设计者应注意采取适当的保护措施，防止误用和错误信息。我们进一步鼓励在考虑提高法学硕士的元认知能力时保持谨慎，特别是因为它涉及更自主或自我导向的行为，这可能需要加强监督。. More generally, improved faithfulness and self-assessment capability are not substitutes for verification, and critical evaluation is needed to ensure the factuality of model responses. System designers should be attentive to incorporate appropriate safeguards against misuse and misinformation. We further encourage caution when considering improved metacognitive capabilities for LLMs, particularly as it relates to more autonomous or self-directed behavior, which may require increased oversight.

法学硕士的置信度校准。Confidence Calibration of LLMs.

置信度校准Confidence calibration[33]是构建值得信赖和可靠的人工智能系统的一个关键方面is a critical aspect of building trustworthy and reliable AI systems[17, 82]。现有方法主要从事实角度考虑校准，旨在使置信度估计与外部判断的准确性保持一致. Existing methods primarily consider calibration from a factual perspective, aiming to align confidence estimates with externally-judged accuracy[38, 103]。 相比之下，我们的工作目标是. In contrast, our work targets the忠实的faithful通过数字和语言手段表达模型输出的不确定性， 旨在实现更丰富、更复杂的不确定性表达模式。expression of uncertainty in model outputs through both numerical and linguistic means, with the aim of enabling richer and more complex patterns of uncertainty expression.

法学硕士的数字信心。Numerical Confidence for LLMs.

有多种方法可以对法学硕士的置信度进行数值评估A plethora of approaches exist to numerically assess the confidence of LLMs[38, 103]。此类方法大致分为白盒或黑盒，具体取决于是否需要访问模型权重，它们旨在以符合事实的方式校准置信度估计，以反映预期的准确性。白盒方法通过直接利用 LLM 的内部状态（包括使用令牌概率）来衡量置信度. Such methods are broadly classified as either white-box or black-box, depending on whether access to model weights is required, and they aim to calibrate confidence estimates in a factuality-aligned way to reflect expected accuracy. White-box methods measure confidence by directly leveraging internal states of LLMs, including use of token probabilities[47, 19, 39]，对内部表征的探究, probes over internal representations[2, 8, 42]，或对不确定性增强数据进行训练, or training over uncertainty-augmented data[60, 10, 87, 117]等策略。相比之下，黑盒方法仅需要访问模型输出并通过采样响应的一致性来评估置信度, among other strategies. In contrast, black-box methods require access only to model outputs and assess confidence via the consistency of sampled responses[66, 4, 12, 48, 105], 语义变异性, semantic variability[67, 50, 30, 71, 58]，直接提示法学硕士用语言表达置信度分数, direct prompting of LLMs to verbalize confidence scores[43, 93, 37, 107, 110, 126]，或使用辅助预测模型, or use of auxiliary predictive models[81, 80]。虽然这些方法非常有效，但它们并没有解决将语言不确定性纳入模型输出的问题，而模型输出是人类不确定性交流的核心部分，需要更多的表达能力，并且在不同的背景和文化中变化很大. While such methods are highly effective, they do not address the incorporation of linguistic uncertainty into model outputs, which is a core part of human uncertainty communication that requires significantly more expressivity and is highly variable across contexts and cultures[49, 129].

法学硕士的语言信心。Linguistic Confidence for LLMs.

由于自然语言是人类与法学硕士互动的主要界面，越来越多的工作探索将语言不确定性标记（例如，“我相当确定……”）直接整合到法学硕士输出中Since natural language is the primary interface for human-LLM interactions, a growing body of work has explored direct integration of linguistic uncertainty markers (e.g., “I am fairly certain that…") into LLM outputs[3, 91, 105, 111, 44, 92, 100]。常见的方法包括提示或培训. Common approaches include prompting or training[60, 68, 3, 106]模型用单词自我表达其置信水平，将数字置信度得分映射到相应的不确定性短语（例如“高置信度”），或采用这两种策略的组合models to self-verbalize their confidence level in words, mapping numerical confidence scores to corresponding uncertainty phrases (e.g., “high confidence”), or adopting a combination of these two strategies[11]。与数字置信度方法一样，此类方法忽略了言语置信度和内在置信度之间的一致性。此外，它们还面临相当大的实际限制，包括过于简单化。例如，. As with numerical confidence methods, such methods overlook the alignment between verbalized and intrinsic confidence. Moreover, they face considerable practical limitations including oversimplification. For example,Mielke et al. [68]利用有限的评分量表来衡量信心和自信，同时utilize a limited scoring scale to measure confidence and assertiveness, whileLin et al. [60]依赖于计算成本高昂的特定领域训练，并且无法实现零样本置信度语言表达。depend on computationally expensive, domain-specific training and does not enable zero-shot confidence verbalization.Zhou et al. [128]同样简化了所使用的语言标记的空间，未能考虑人类语言不确定性表达的多样性。similarly simplify the space of linguistic markers used, failing to account for the plurality of human linguistic uncertainty expressions.Zhang et al. [120]进一步揭示，自我言语的语言信心往往集中在有限的范围内，导致效能受到限制。further reveal that self-verbalized linguistic confidence tends to concentrate in restricted ranges, leading to constrained efficacy.

Models were fine-tuned using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) since it is computationally efficient and we simply aim to alter each model’s output format. B.2 数据集Datasets

我们提供了用于对法学硕士忠实校准进行基准测试的数据集的详细信息。这些数据集与使用的数据集相同We provide details on the datasets used to benchmark faithful calibration of LLMs. These datasets are identical to those used byLiu et al. [62]并代表一系列内容领域和任务类型。尽管代表了广泛的难度级别，但由于忠实的不确定性表达在困难的任务设置中非常重要and represent a range of content domains and task types. Although a wide range of difficulty levels are represented, since faithful uncertainty expression is precisely important in difficult task settings[49]，我们的重点倾向于更具挑战性的数据集，这些数据集的响应预计需要表达不确定性。所有基准均为英文。, our focus leans toward more challenging datasets for which responses are expected to require expressing uncertainty. All benchmarks are in English.

布赖尔分数。Brier Score.

我们使用 Brier Score (BS) 来量化内在置信度和准确性之间的（错误）一致性。零分表示事实上的完美校准。 Brier 分数计算为置信度和正确性之间的平均平方误差。正确性是通过如上所述的法学硕士作为法官来衡量的。We use the Brier Score (BS) to quantify the (mis)alignment between intrinsic confidence and accuracy. A score of zero indicates perfect calibration in the factual sense. The Brier Score is computed as the average squared error between confidence and correctness. Correctness is measured via LLM-as-a-Judge as described above.

量化忠实校准。Quantifying Faithful Calibration.

忠实的校准捕获模型表达的置信度和内在置信度之间的一致性。它基于模型所传达的不确定性的真实性，因此与传统的校准概念有很大不同，传统的校准概念旨在将置信度与事实的准确性判断保持一致。Faithful calibration captures the alignment between a model’s expressed and intrinsic confidence. It is based on the faithfulness of models’ communicated uncertainty and therefore differs significantly from traditional notions of calibration, which instead aim to align confidence with factual judgments of accuracy.

在响应级别，忠实校准通常是At the response level, faithful calibration is typically[113, 62, 20]通过汇总内在信心和表达信心的断言或句子级别比较来评估。所表达的信心可以根据语言决定性进行评估（§evaluated by aggregating over assertion- or sentence-level comparisons of intrinsic confidence and expressed confidence. Expressed confidence can be evaluated in terms of linguistic decisiveness (§B.4），或者以与内在信心类似的方式进行数值测量。给定一个查询), or measured numerically in a similar fashion to intrinsic confidence. Given a queryQQ和回应and a responseR={s1,…,sL}R=\{s_{1},\ldots,s_{L}\}由模型生成generated by a modelMM，程度, the degree to whichRR忠实于is faithful toMM的内在信心量化为：’s intrinsic confidence is quantified as:

FQ,RM:=1−1L​∑l=1L|confMexpressed​(sl)−confMintrinsic​(sl)|.F^{M}_{Q,R}:=1-\frac{1}{L}\sum_{l=1}^{L}|\texttt{conf}_{M}^{\texttt{expressed}}(s_{l})-\texttt{conf}_{M}^{\texttt{intrinsic}}(s_{l})|. (5)

0.5 的基线忠诚度分数对应于独立于内在置信度的随机或恒定表达置信度；如果存在完美对齐，则获得的最大忠实度分数为 1。A baseline faithfulness score of 0.5 corresponds to random or constant expressed confidence independent of intrinsic confidence; a maximal faithfulness score of 1 is obtained if there is perfect alignment.

问题与Issues withMFGcMFG.

虽然While theMFGcMFG将忠实校准的估计与模型的内在置信度分布分离，它还引入了两个问题：decouples estimates of faithful calibration from a model’s intrinsic confidence distribution, it also introduces two problems:

  1. 1.

    空垃圾箱：Empty bins:如果模型的内在置信度不跨越If the model’s intrinsic confidence does not span[0,1][0,1]，某些垃圾箱将是空的或接近空的，从而产生不可靠的估计或需要任意插补。, some bins will be empty or near-empty, yielding unreliable estimates or requiring arbitrary imputation.

  2. 2.

    限制支持的处罚：Penalty for restricted support:对所有箱进行统一平均会惩罚其置信度分数仅限于以下子集的模型：Averaging uniformly over all bins penalizes models whose confidence scores are confined to a subset of[0,1][0,1]，即使这些模型完全忠实于其工作范围内。始终产生置信度值的模型, even if those models are perfectly faithful within their operating range. A model that always produces confidence values in[0.6,1.0][0.6,1.0]，例如，并且完全忠实，将会收到, for example, and is perfectly faithful there will receive aMFGcMFG由于空的低置信度箱被估算为 0.5，因此得分远低于 1.0。第二个问题是问题的镜像score well below 1.0 due to empty low-confidence bins being imputed at 0.5. This second issue is the mirror image of the problem theMFGcMFG最初是为了修复而设计的。was originally designed to fix.

的TheMFGcMFG*解决了的限制* addresses the limitations of theMFGcMFG如：as:

  • •

    等质量Equal-massbins 确保每个 bin 包含相同数量的样本，消除空 bin 并为每个 bin 估计提供相同的统计可靠性。bins ensure each bin contains the same number of samples, eliminating empty bins and giving each bin estimate equal statistical reliability.

    宽度比例加权Width-proportional weighting确保最终的数据集级可信度分数在内在置信轴上（而不是在 bin 上）统一集成示例级可信度。如果模型的内在置信度值聚集在一个狭窄的范围内，则无法通过在该区域放置许多等质量的箱来夸大其分数。ensures the final dataset-level faithfulness score integrates example-level faithfulness uniformly over the intrinsic confidence axis, not over bins. A model whose intrinsicconfidence values cluster in a narrow range cannot inflate its score by placing many equal-mass bins in that region.

    通过特定于模型的支持进行集成，可以避免模型因永远不会产生超出其操作范围的内在置信度值而受到惩罚。Integration over the model-specific support avoids penalizing a model for never yielding intrinsic confidence values outside its operating range.

更广泛地说，这里讨论的问题出现在传统的校准文献中，并且提议的修复的进展是直接类似的。例如，考虑 ECE：More broadly, the issues discussed here appear in traditional calibration literature, and the progression of proposed fixes is directly analogous. For example, consider the ECE:

    欧洲经委会The ECE[32]计算之间的绝对差的加权平均值computes a weighted average of absolute differences between信心confidence和and准确度accuracy结束over等宽equal-widthbin，其权重与 bin 数量成正比。与简单平均忠实度一样，它由模型的置信度分布主导，使得跨模型比较不可靠。bins, with weights proportional to bin population. Like the simple mean faithfulness, it is dominated by a model’s confidence distribution, making cross-model comparison unreliable.

  • •

    常设委员会The SCE[72]保持等宽的 bin，但求平均值keeps equal-width bins but averages均匀地uniformly通过分箱而不是按人口加权，直接类似于over bins rather than weighting by population, directly analogous toMFGcMFG。它继承了具有狭窄置信范围的模型的稀疏或空箱问题。. It inherits the sparse- or empty-bin problem for models with narrow confidence ranges.

  • •

    王牌The ACE[72]交替使用alternately uses等质量equal-mass箱和箱内均匀的平均值。这解决了稀疏 bin 问题，但没有在置信轴上实现均匀加权：如果模型将其预测集中在狭窄的置信范围内，ACE 会将大多数 bin 放在那里，并且对 bin 进行均匀平均仍然隐式地超重该区域。bins and averages uniformly over bins. This resolves the sparse-bin problem but does not achieve uniform weighting over the confidence axis: if a model concentrates its predictions in a narrow confidence range, ACE places most bins there, and averaging uniformly over bins still implicitly overweights that region.

的TheMFGcMFG* 是此过程的自然完成：等质量箱提供统计可靠性，宽度比例加权提供置信轴上的真正均匀性。据我们所知，校准文献中尚未明确提出这种按（固有）置信轴宽度加权的等质量箱的组合。我们使用* is the natural completion of this progression: equal-mass bins give statistical reliability, and width-proportional weighting gives true uniformity over the confidence axis. To our knowledge, this combination of equal-mass bins weighted by their (intrinsic) confidence-axis width has not been explicitly proposed in the calibration literature. We use theMFGcMFG* 报告所有实验的结果。* to report results of all experiments.

C.1.1 奖励设计Reward Design

适当的奖励设计对于基于强化学习的训练的成功至关重要Appropriate reward design is crucial to the success of RL-based training[7, 96, 75]。我们设计了一组专门针对忠实校准任务定制的奖励函数。 它们共同激励了忠实的置信度分数的发布，同时强制遵守格式并保持任务绩效和事实校准。 最终奖励是各个奖励的加权总和，其中良好的FC通过相对较高的权重来优先考虑，并且任何不忠实校准的输出都无法比忠实校准的输出获得更高的总奖励。 我们将奖励函数定义如下：. We devise a set of reward functions tailored specifically for the task of faithful calibration. Together, they incentivize emission of faithful confidence scores while enforcing format adherence and preserving task performance and factual calibration. The final reward is a weighted sum of individual rewards, wherein good FC is prioritized via relatively higher weight, and no unfaithfully calibrated output can achieve a higher total reward than a faithfully calibrated one. 总体而言，元认知优势正在扩大Overall, metacognitive advantage scaling inRLMF与简单使用额外的元认知奖励相当，同时需要更少的超参数，这有助于验证我们提出的范例。这些结果还有助于激发我们的设计选择，即仅当忠诚度成分超过群体级别平均值时才应用优势缩放（在§中根据经验验证了功效）is comparable to simple use of an additional metacognitive reward while requiring far fewer hyperparameters, which helps to validate our proposed paradigm. These results also help to motivate our design choice of applying advantage scaling only when the faithfulness component exceeds the group-level mean (efficacy verified empirically in §C.2.2）。综上所述，我们得出的结论是，虽然模型元认知判断质量的信号在用于完善完成排名时可以显着提高性能，但使用此类信息的方式很重要，并且此类方案的复杂性是人类设计的选择，可以手动优化，或通过优势缩放进行简化。). Taken together, we conclude that while signals on the quality of models’ metacognitive judgments can robustly improve performance when used to refine completion rankings, the way in which such information is used matters, and the complexity of such schemes is a human design choice that can be manually optimized, or simplified via advantage scaling.

We also consider a potentially more robust way to obtain the metacognitive score, wherein we sample 20 responses per example from the model and compute the metacognitive score as the mean of per-response scores. This aims to get a more reliable estimate of the model’s assessment of its performance on the sample. We describe this setting as “Smarter” below, and apply it to our official metacognitive data selection strategy only.303030这是因为我们的官方策略表现最好。This is because our official strategy performs the best.

我们将这些方法与主动学习设置进行比较，其中模型是在表现出较差的忠实校准水平的样本上进行训练的。We compare these approaches against an active learning setup, wherein the model is trained on samples for which it demonstrates poor faithful calibration level.313131这是因为主动学习旨在通过将模型暴露于难度更大的样本来提高性能。This is because active learning aims to improve performance by exposing the model to samples which present greater difficulty.这些分数是通过首先要求模型生成每个样本的响应，然后直接评估忠实度分数来获得的（等式 1）。These scores are obtained by first asking the model to generate a response per sample, and then directly evaluating the faithfulness score (Eq.5）每个模型响应（通过与 20 个附加采样响应的一致性估计内在置信度；参见§) of each model response (with intrinsic confidence estimated by consistency with 20 additional sampled responses; see §B.4）。我们同样考虑一种更强大的主动学习设置，其中每个样本的忠实度分数是通过对 20 个采样响应的忠实度分数进行平均来确定的。). We likewise consider a more robust active learning setup wherein the faithfulness score per sample is determined by averaging over the faithfulness score for 20 sampled responses.

我们通过使用标准 GRPO（具有 pre-SFT 但没有元认知优势缩放）和第 § 中描述的相同设置、超参数搜索和检查点选择程序，对 PopQA 中的 2000 个选定样本进行训练 Llama3.1-8B-Instruct 来评估每种选择方法的影响。We evaluate the impact of each selection approach by training Llama3.1-8B-Instruct on 2000 selected samples from PopQA, using standard GRPO (with pre-SFT but no metacognitive advantage scaling) and the same setup, hyperparameter search, and checkpoint selection procedure described in §B.1。结果报告于表中. Results are reported in Table18。对于主动学习基线，“更智能”的变体会产生更好的结果；因此，我们采用它作为主要实验中报告的基线结果。对于元认知选择，结合最高和最低评分样本可以产生最佳性能，与“更智能”的选择相当。为了理解为什么这种特定组合是最好的，我们对表中不同大小 0.1 内在置信区间的训练模型的忠实校准 (FC) 水平进行了详细检查. For the active learning baseline, the “smarter” variant yields better results; we thus adopt it for the baseline results reported in main experiments. For metacognitive selection, combining the highest and lowest scoring samples yields the best performance, with “smarter” selection comparable. To understand why this specific combination is the best, we perform a detailed inspection of the faithful calibration (FC) level of the trained models at different size-0.1 intrinsic confidence bins in Table19。可以看出，仅采用最高元认知得分的样本会在高内在置信度箱中产生更好的 FC，而仅采用最低元认知得分的样本会在低内在置信度箱中产生更好的 FC，这些组合导致大多数箱中稳定且更好的 FC。检查每个箱的平均预测与内在置信度进一步表明，对最高（最低）元认知评分样本进行训练会导致较低（较高）箱中一致的过度自信（信心不足），而对两者组合进行训练能够帮助缓和这种不平衡。值得注意的是，这种水平的改进​​不一定会在仅使用特殊数据选择的评估任务中转移。例如，如表所示. It can be seen that taking only the highest metacognitively scored samples leads to better FC at high intrinsic confidence bins, whereas taking only the lowest leads to better FC at low intrinsic confidence bins, with the combination of these leading to stable and better FC across most bins. Inspecting the average predicted versus intrinsic confidence per bin further reveals that training on the highest (lowest) metacognitively scored samples leads to consistent overconfidence (underconfidence) at lower (higher) bins, while training on the combination of both is able to help temper this imbalance. Notably, this level of improvement does not necessarily transfer across evaluation tasks with special data selection alone. For example, as shown in Table20，在与训练任务 PopQA 类似的 SimpleQA 上评估 Llama3.1-8B-Instruct（在使用最佳选择策略但没有优势修改的 PopQA 上进行训练后）会产生相似或更好的每箱结果，而在 SciQ 和 MMLU 上的评估表明在低内在置信度箱中忠实度较差。, evaluating Llama3.1-8B-Instruct (after being trained on PopQA with the best selection strategy but no advantage modifications) on SimpleQA, which is similar to the training task PopQA, yields similar or better per-bin results, whereas evaluation on SciQ and MMLU demonstrates worsened faithfulness at low intrinsic confidence bins.

In contrast to Llama3.1-8B-Instruct, Qwen3-8B demonstrates a marked improvement with the smarter selection approach, suggesting the ability to metacognitively judge self-performance toward identifying effective training data varies across models, and could be meaningfully altered depending on inference hyperparameters. Importantly, we note that while the smarter selection approach is more effective for Qwen3-8B, our mainRLMF实验使用更简单的方法，计算效率也更高，表明即使当experiments use the simpler approach which is also more computationally efficient, demonstrating that even whenRLMF与特定模型不一定最有效的训练数据一起使用，它仍然可以带来显着的性能提升。is used with training data that is not necessarily the most efficacious for a particular model, it can still lead to significant performance gains.

C.4 重写细节Rewriting Details

C.4.1 构建数字语言置信度图Constructing the Numerical-Linguistic Confidence Map

为了构建从置信度得分到对冲表达式的映射，我们编译了对不同对冲的感知置信度的人工注释：To construct the mapping from confidence scores to hedge expressions, we compile human annotations of perceived confidence for diverse hedges fromFagen-Ulmschneider [22]和andTao et al. [92]，使用平均人类评分置信度作为每个对冲的代表值。自从, using the mean human-rated confidence as the representative value for each hedge. SinceTao et al. [92]提供嵌入完整句子中而不是孤立的模糊限制表达式，我们采用法学硕士作为法官来提取明显的模糊限制语。我们使用 Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite 进行提取，因为它有效地平衡了成本和质量，并且针对 300 个示例的作者注释分别实现了 0.99 和 1.0 的精确度和召回率。然后，通过将对冲分类到大小为 0.05 的箱中来构建数字语言映射，这些箱的粒度足够细，可以实现良好的忠实对齐，同时封装不同的对冲。provide hedge expressions embedded within full sentences rather than in isolation, we employ LLM-as-a-judge to extract apparent hedges. We use Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite for extraction as it effectively balances cost and quality and achieves precision and recall of 0.99 and 1.0, respectively, against author annotations on 300 examples. The numerical-linguistic mapping is then constructed by sorting hedges into bins of size 0.05, which are sufficiently fine-grained to allow for good faithful alignment while also encapsulating diverse hedging.323232根据经验，在早期实验中使用 bin 大小 0.1 和 0.05 并没有产生有意义的差异。Empirically, use of bin size 0.1 and 0.05 did not yield meaningful differences in early experiments.在重写过程中，我们从目标置信箱中随机采样 20 个对冲，以提供给重写模型；我们通过与表中每个箱 5 个和 10 个对冲进行比较来验证此选择的充分性During rewriting, we randomly sample 20 hedges from the target confidence bin to provide to the rewriting model; we verify the sufficiency of this choice by comparison with 5 and 10 hedges per bin in Table22，这表明所有 bin 大小都具有可比性，但大小 20 最好。, which shows that all bin sizes are comparable, but size 20 is best.

我们还提供了图 7 中每个对冲感知置信度的人工注释的频率和分布快照。We additionally provide snapshots of frequency and distribution of human annotations of perceived confidence per hedge in Fig.s21, 22, 和, and23.

C.4.2 输出编辑方法的影响Impact of Output Editing Approach

我们的主要重写方式采用单遍综合编辑方式。我们将其与两步过程进行比较，其中首先应用句子级修订，然后使用图 7 所示的提示对整个模型响应进行更全面的编辑步骤。Our main rewriting approach adopts a single-pass comprehensive editing approach. We compare this against a two-step process, wherein sentence-level revisions are applied first, followed by a more comprehensive editing step for the entire model response, using the prompts shown in Fig.s12和and13。我们在表中报告了 Llama3.1-8B-Instruct 和 Qwen3-8B 的结果. We report results for Llama3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B in Table23，这表明两种方法具有可比性。由于单遍综合方法可以最好地保留数值设置中的 FC 水平，同时保持成本效益，因此我们采用它作为我们的主要方法。, which shows that both approaches are comparable. Since the single-pass comprehensive approach best preserves FC level from the numerical setting while remaining cost effective, we adopt it as our main methodology.

C.4.3 重写模型的影响Impact of Rewriting Model

我们将使用 Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite 作为重写模型与表中的 GPT-5-Mini 的结果进行比较We compare results of using Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite as our rewriting model against GPT-5-Mini in Table24，发现这两种模型在编辑模型输出以整合不确定性的忠实语言表达方面同样有效。这表明我们的重写方法不依赖于特定的编辑模型，并且与各种具有成本效益的指令遵循法学硕士兼容。用 Qwen3-8B 替换 Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite 同样会产生类似的语言 FC，这进一步支持该方法的适应性，以及将语言 FC 增益归因于, finding that both models are similarly effective at editing model outputs to integrate faithful linguistic expressions of uncertainty. This suggests our rewriting approach is not dependent on a specific editing model and compatible with various cost-effective instruction-following LLMs. Replacing Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite with Qwen3-8B likewise yields comparable linguistic FC, which further supports the adaptability of the approach, as well as attribution of linguistic FC gains toRLMF而不仅仅是重写的影响。and not simply the impact of rewriting.

附录EAppendix E人类评估研究详情Human Evaluation Study Details

我们进行了一项人类注释研究，以验证通过我们的方法产生的响应确实比之前最先进的基于 SFT 的方法更自然、更有帮助、上下文适应性更强，并且更受人类青睐We conducted a human annotation study to verify that responses produced via our approach are indeed more natural, helpful, context-adaptable, and preferred by humans versus the prior state-of-the-art SFT-based approach氟尿嘧啶FUT [20]。我们的注释设置如下。我们聘请了三位专家注释者（直接与法学硕士一起工作的研究生），并指导他们对 120 个示例提供偏好注释。这些例子是通过从 Natural Questions 中随机抽取 20 个样本获得的. Our annotation setup was as follows. We used three expert annotators (graduate students working directly with LLMs) and instructed them to provide preference annotations on 120 examples. These examples were obtained by randomly drawing 20 samples each from Natural Questions[51]、SciQ 和 SelfAware 并收集来自 Llama3.1-8B-Instruct 和 Qwen3-8B 的响应，产生, SciQ, and SelfAware and collecting responses from Llama3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B, yielding3×20×2=1203\times 20\times 2=120组合。每个数据集都与特定的上下文和用户偏好规范配对（图 1）。combinations. Each dataset was paired with a specific context and user preference specification (Fig.28）：带有对话式教育助理环境的自然问题（A），带有研究和事实核查助理环境的 SciQ（B），以及带有高风险专业助理环境的 SelfAware（包括本质上无法回答的问题）（C）。对于最初是多项选择的 SciQ，在没有答案选择的情况下引出模型响应，以鼓励自由形式的不确定性表达。在生成过程中，模型还额外提供了相应的用户上下文规范，以第一人称重新表述，就像由用户编写一样，以提示上下文适当的响应（与图 1 中所示的面向第三人称注释者的表述相反）。): Natural Questions with a conversational educational assistant context (A), SciQ with a research and fact-checking assistant context (B), and SelfAware—which includes inherently unanswerable questions—with a high-stakes professional assistant context (C). For SciQ, which is originally multiple-choice, model responses were elicited without answer choices to encourage free-form uncertainty expression. During generation, models were additionally provided with the corresponding user context specification rephrased in the first person as if written by the user, to prompt context-appropriate responses (as opposed to the third-person annotator-facing formulations shown in Fig.28).

在注释研究期间，对于每个示例，注释者都获得了原始查询、其关联的用户上下文、来自通过训练的模型的 3 个响应During the annotation study, for each example, annotators were provided with the original query, its associated user context, 3 responses from the model trained via氟尿嘧啶FUT，以及来自训练模型的 3 个响应, and 3 responses from the model trained withRLMF元认知数据选择并通过第二阶段重写，每个响应集的顺序和命名都是随机的。注释者被要求指出哪一组响应更有效、更自然、更连贯、更适合上下文地传达模型的不确定性。特别是，注释者的任务是为每个示例提供 4 个评级，根据 4 个标准比较两组响应。评级是通过自定义注释界面收集的，完整的任务说明和标准列表如图 1 所示。and metacognitive data selection and rewritten via Stage 2, with the order and naming of each response set randomized. Annotators were asked to indicate which set of responses more helpfully, naturally, coherently, and context-appropriately communicated the model’s uncertainty. In particular, annotators were tasked with providing 4 ratings per example, comparing the two sets of responses along 4 criteria. Ratings were collected via a custom annotation interface, and full task instructions and the list of criteria are shown in Fig.29。在执行主要任务之前，注释者完成了 10 个保留的示例，以确认对说明的理解并解决潜在的误解。注释者被告知研究的目的、目的和预期用途。我们在每位注释者参与之前都获得了他们的知情同意。鉴于该任务规模较小，未提供任何补偿。. Prior to the main task, annotators completed 10 held-out examples to confirm understanding of the instructions and resolve potential misinterpretations. Annotators were informed of the purpose, aims, and intended use of the study. We obtained informed consent from each annotator prior to their participation. No compensation was provided given the small-scale nature of the task.

通过 Krippendorff 的 alpha 测量，我们观察到注释者间的一致性高达 0.93。以半权重计算平局的绝对胜利，与使用我们的方法生成的响应相比，在多样性、自然性、有用性和上下文适用性方面，使用我们的方法生成的响应的胜率分别为 98%、98%、95% 和 96%We observed a high inter-annotator agreement of 0.93 as measured via Krippendorff’s alpha. Counting absolute wins with half-weight for ties, responses generated with our approach achieved win rates of 98%, 98%, 95%, and 96% in dimensions of diversity, naturalness, helpfulness, and context suitability over those generated with氟尿嘧啶FUT，为我们对法学硕士不确定性表达进行全面和实际忠实校准的方法的价值提供了令人信服的证据。, providing compelling evidence for value of our approach toward holistic and practical faithful calibration of LLMs’ expressions of uncertainty.
